dictDef: A grimoire written in runes that rewrites itself every time someone opens it. Each page is a road, each road ends at a castle, and each castle keeps a king who does not want the book closed.
dictEty: From rune + grimoire. Formerly known as Grimoire.

faq: What kind of game is Runemoire?
A roguelike deckbuilder in pixel art. You pick a class, walk a road of six acts, and fight with a deck you build along the way. Every run is a new page.
On PC, through Steam. The store page is coming soon; leave your email above and the grimoire will write to you on launch day.
English, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, French and German, in the game and on this site.
When does it launch, and for how much?
Not announced yet. We will not guess here; the launch email will carry the news.
Can I stream it or make videos?
Yes. Stream it, record it, monetize your videos. A link back to runemoire.com is appreciated, never required.
I write about games. Where is the press kit?
At the bottom of this page: logos, art and screenshots in one zip, plus the trailers. For anything else, write to {contact}.
It was. Same book, new name: Runemoire.

pressAboutText: Runemoire is a pixel-art roguelike deckbuilder. Pick one of three classes, cross six cursed acts, chain combos and break the signature curse of each boss. Formerly known as Grimoire.
cursesLead: In the endless road, every cycle offers two curses; you must take one.
sealsLead: Ten seals, stacked one on top of the other, unlocked per class. Win on one to break the next.
endlessLead: After the sixth act, the road loops through the biomes again, harder every cycle.
